background: NBK International is the London-based bank of National Bank of Kuwait, the largest bank in Kuwait, serving the parent's Gulf clients in Europe with private banking, trade finance and property lending, funded by deposits and the parent.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ on average across two of the three main agencies, both at that level and on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 25 Nov 2025, resting on the Kuwaiti parent. Capital is strong against UK mid-sized banks, with CET1 of 20.4% and leverage of 13.2% both in the top quarter against the peer medians. Liquidity is mixed: LCR of 497% is in the top quarter, while NSFR of 120% is in the bottom quarter and has fallen 7 points since 31 Dec 2024. Leverage has risen 1.1 points and LCR 67 points over the same period, with figures to 31 Dec 2025, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
